total_supply.meaning: ERC-20 totalSupply value used as scaling factor in share-minting and redemption formulas

sum_balances.meaning: sum of balanceOf[] across all accounts (minted, backed shares)

ghost_shares.meaning: 1,000,000 shares included in totalSupply but never minted to any account

scaling_uses_total_supply.meaning: both key share-minting and redemption formulas use totalSupply as a scaling factor

value_skimmed.meaning: value is permanently skimmed into the void, disadvantaging honest users

assumptions: The 1,000,000 ghost shares are a literal constructor-time value included in totalSupply.
Share-minting and redemption formulas scale by totalSupply, so an inflated totalSupply dilutes per-share value.
No attacker transaction is required; the flaw is a constructor-time state condition.

unresolved.description: Report gives no concrete numeric expected-versus-actual share or asset amounts for the permanent value-skimming effect, so the magnitude of skimmed value cannot be quantified; only the qualitative permanent-disadvantage outcome is stated.

limitations: Conservation is expressed at the share-count level (totalSupply vs sum of balances); the permanent value-skimming impact is carried as a qualitative Boolean because no numeric asset amounts are reported.
The report does not state whether 1,000,000 is a literal constructor argument or illustrative; treated as literal per the statement text.
